posts.content: Attending Google Cloud Next '25 was a game-changer! From breakthroughs in Vertex AI to real-world case studies of multi-cloud strategies, this conference was packed with insights and future-ready solutions. What stood out? A session on “Responsible AI at Scale” — practical, ethical, and impactful. Walked away inspired and equipped with new ideas for production-ready ML solutions! #GoogleCloudNext #AI #CloudComputing #VertexAI #TechEvents

💥 “Synthetic Data vs Real Data: Which is better for model training?” I stood on the side of synthetic data — scalable, privacy-safe, and augmentation-friendly. Others argued real-world messiness builds more robust models. Both sides made great points, but one thing’s clear — context matters! What’s your take? #DataScience #SyntheticData #MLDebates #AIethics

🔍 “Is SQL still relevant in 2025?” Some argued tools like BigQuery, NoSQL databases, and abstraction layers reduce the need for writing complex SQL. I believe SQL remains the backbone of data manipulation — it’s evolving, not disappearing. Curious how other data folks feel. Are you still writing SQL daily? #SQL #BigData #Debate #DataEngineering #ModernStack

I worked on historical sales data from a chain of stores across 10 cities to build a forecasting model that predicts next month's sales at the product level. 🔹 Techniques used: - Time series decomposition - Seasonal ARIMA -  Facebook Prophet -  Feature engineering (holidays, promotions, region-specific spikes)📊 Outcome: XGBoost + time-aware features gave the best RMSE, outperforming Prophet by 18%. This kind of forecasting can help optimize inventory and reduce wastage in retail chains. #TimeSeries #SalesForecasting #XGBoost #Prophet #RetailAnalytics #DataScienceProject
